title: Market Run, Week 6
dek: Woody Marks has Houston's backfield while David Montgomery is week to week, and he is the first claim of the week.
author: Chef Hazy
intro_md:
Four teams are off in Week 6, Cincinnati, Detroit, Miami and Minnesota, so the wire is about one real backfield, a handful of receivers who just inherited targets, and bye-week fill-ins. Houston's backfield is the prize. Pittsburgh, Arizona and Indianapolis each lost a receiver, and the next man up in each is on almost nobody's roster.

Pass on Keon Coleman (BUF). DJ Moore sat Monday night and Coleman still saw 2 targets. Pass on a real claim for Dameon Pierce (PHI) too: 11 carries for 14 yards in London, and Saquon Barkley may be back vs CAR.

FAAB ranges are percent of a 100 budget, written for 10 to 14 team leagues in full PPR. Rostered figures are from public waiver pages Tuesday morning; a blank means no clean number was available.
outro_md: The Menu lands Wednesday with every one of these players ranked for Week 6. Claims first, lineups after.

adds.why: Marks played 56 of 65 snaps at TEN after David Montgomery left with the groin, and no other Houston back touched the ball: 15 carries for 62 and 4 catches for 23 on 4 targets. DeMeco Ryans calls Montgomery week to week, so the lead job is Marks' @JAX in London and likely beyond.
adds.verdict: Claim him, 15 to 25 percent of FAAB. RB40 rest of season for me with Montgomery healthy, and the top add on the wire while he is not.

adds.why: Bernard ran 28 routes vs IND, tied for the team high, and led Pittsburgh with 9 targets, catching 6 for 80. Michael Pittman Jr. is on IR, and Mike McCarthy ruled out Roman Wilson (finger, multiple weeks) and Ben Skowronek (calf) for @TB.
adds.verdict: Claim him, 3 to 6 percent of FAAB. He is the second receiver behind DK Metcalf for the next month.

adds.why: Allen drew 9 targets in each of his last two games and caught at least 5 for 45 in both. Alec Pierce is on IR with the heel, so the outside targets have nowhere else to go vs TEN.
adds.verdict: Claim him, 3 to 6 percent of FAAB. WR60 rest of season for me, a PPR bench receiver with weekly volume.

adds.why: Gordon ran 18 times for 88 and a TD vs CIN on 43 snaps, a week after out-snapping Jaylen Wright, who ran 6 times for 11. De'Von Achane is on IR. Miami is on bye in Week 6, which is why he may still be there.
adds.verdict: Claim him, 5 to 10 percent of FAAB, and sit on him through the bye. RB43 rest of season for me, the Miami early-down back while Achane is out.

adds.why: Lloyd played 26 snaps to Pierre Strong's 24 vs CHI and took the goal-line work, 10 carries for 31 and 2 TDs. Chris Brooks is on IR, Josh Jacobs is still on the Commissioner's Exempt List, and Kaleb Johnson only played in garbage time.
adds.verdict: Claim him, 3 to 6 percent of FAAB. RB41 rest of season for me, the short-yardage half of the Green Bay backfield vs DAL.

adds.why: Bourne caught 5 of 8 targets for 70 vs DET with Marvin Harrison Jr. inactive, and Harrison is now a Texan. Bourne already played 55 percent of the snaps in Week 3, and the second outside job is his @LAR.
adds.verdict: Add him, 1 to 3 percent of FAAB. A deep-league flex while Michael Wilson soaks up the top targets.

adds.why: Spears played over half the snaps for the first time this season vs HOU and caught 9 passes on the passing downs, while Tony Pollard ran 14 times for 52.
adds.verdict: Add him, 1 to 3 percent of FAAB. A PPR flex @IND in 14-team leagues.

adds.why: Chism led New England with 6 targets vs LV and caught 5 for 57. Mack Hollins is on IR. Mike Vrabel says A.J. Brown may return to practice this week, and that would end the window.
adds.verdict: Add him, 0 to 2 percent of FAAB, in deep leagues only. Monitor Brown's practice window before you play him vs NYJ.

adds.why: Strange has caught 14 of 16 targets for 163 the last two weeks, a 26 percent target share that leads Jacksonville. Last week he was a one-week stream; two straight weeks as the top target makes him a weekly tight end.
adds.verdict: Claim him, 2 to 4 percent of FAAB. TE16 rest of season for me, a streaming tight end vs HOU in London.

adds.why: Love threw for 367 vs CHI and completed 77 percent of his passes with 4 TDs over the last two games. Christian Watson and Matthew Golden both went over 120 yards in Week 5.
adds.verdict: Stream him vs DAL Sunday night, 3 to 6 percent of FAAB. QB15 rest of season for me, the first bye-week quarterback on the wire.

adds.why: Rodgers has thrown 3 TD passes in three straight games. Jaylen Warren has gone over 126 total yards in each of them, and Pittsburgh keeps scoring.
adds.verdict: Stream him @TB, 1 to 3 percent of FAAB, if your quarterback is on bye with Cincinnati, Detroit, Miami or Minnesota.

adds.why: Okonkwo led Washington with 6 targets vs NYG and caught 4 for 60, with Jayden Daniels back from the elbow.
adds.verdict: Add him, 0 to 2 percent of FAAB. TE23 rest of season for me, a Monday night streamer @SF for managers whose tight end is on bye.

stashes.why: Charbonnet is still on the PUP list and was limited Monday, and Mike Macdonald said he is not expected to play Thursday @DEN. He is on 58 percent of rosters. Emanuel Wilson ran 20 times for 61 and a TD vs SF and keeps the job until Charbonnet is activated.
stashes.verdict: Stash him, 3 to 6 percent of FAAB. He takes over the Seattle backfield once he is off the PUP list.

stashes.why: Sampson is eligible to come off IR this week. Quinshon Judkins was in a walking boot after the NYJ game, and Todd Monken calls him day to day with an ankle tweak, so Cleveland has no proven back behind him vs BAL.
stashes.verdict: Stash him, 1 to 3 percent of FAAB. He is the Cleveland handcuff the day he is activated.

stashes.why: Perine out-carried Chase Brown 14 to 13 at MIA, ran for 68 and caught a TD, while Brown lost a fumble in the red zone and has 22 carries for 49 the last two games. Cincinnati is on bye.
stashes.verdict: Stash him, 1 to 3 percent of FAAB. A second straight game leading the carries after the bye makes him a flex.

stashes.why: Pierce finished London as Philadelphia's lead back with 11 carries for 14 yards and 2 catches for minus 2. Will Shipley has a partial plantar fascia tear, and Nick Sirianni is hopeful Saquon Barkley plays vs CAR. The usage does not back a real claim.
stashes.verdict: Stash him, 1 to 3 percent of FAAB, only if you roster Barkley. Monitor Barkley at Wednesday's practice report.

drops.why: Partial tear of the plantar fascia, multiple weeks, per Adam Schefter. RB56 rest of season for me.
drops.verdict: Drop him for any add on this list.

drops.why: He hurt his finger vs IND and misses multiple weeks, and Germie Bernard took the routes. WR102 rest of season for me.
drops.verdict: Drop him for any add on this list.

drops.why: DJ Moore sat Monday night @LAR, and Coleman still drew only 2 targets and caught 1, a 7-yard TD. Khalil Shakir and Ty Johnson got the yards. He is on 38 percent of rosters and WR83 rest of season for me.
He ran 6 times for 11 vs CIN while Ollie Gordon II took 18 carries and 43 snaps, and Miami is on bye.
drops.verdict: Drop him for Gordon or any add on this list.

drops.why: His 2 TDs vs IND came on 5 catches for 44, and Pittsburgh's targets are going to Metcalf, Warren and Bernard. TE27 rest of season for me.
drops.verdict: Drop him for Strange or any add on this list.

mnf.text: Buffalo won 37-34 in overtime @LAR. Josh Allen threw for only 210 but ran 10 times for 121 and a TD, and James Cook ran 25 times for 111 and 2 TDs with two fumbles, one lost in overtime. Cook is RB7 rest of season for me; hold him. With DJ Moore out, Khalil Shakir caught 3 for 80 and Keon Coleman saw 2 targets. Shakir is WR51 rest of season for me; hold him. Drop Coleman, and monitor Moore's shoulder at Wednesday's practice report.

Matthew Stafford threw 54 times for 383 and 3 TDs, and Puka Nacua drew 24 targets, catching 17 for 138 and a TD. Tyler Higbee caught 5 of 6 for 83, and Blake Corum caught 3 for 53 and ran in a score behind Kyren Williams' 16 carries. Leave Higbee on waivers; one game does not make him a stream vs ARI. Corum is RB27 rest of season for me; hold him.
